name: messenger-message-saver
description: Chrome extension that saves Messenger messages on facebook.com and messenger.com, keeps unsent/edited messages readable, adds Unseen mode, downloads photos/videos/reels, and has an English/Bangla interface and an optional PIN lock.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: node --test tests/e2e/extension.e2e.test.js && node --test tests/e2e/update.e2e.test.js && node --test tests/e2e/privacy-language.e2e.test.js && node --test tests/e2e/package.e2e.test.js
